summary: Verified deployment-blocker fix and the related changes. Static: no `settle_late` anywhere in backend source. erase_companion is called only from request_deletion (POST /api/account/delete-request) and owner_panel.decide(). sweep(), sweep_loop() and startup() never touch account deletions. Behaviour, run on the scratch DB: server.sweep() leaves the Rapid Fire profile of a pending request alone. Owner 'complete' accepts a request stuck in 'erasing', erases again and saves history [requested, rapid_fire_erased_again, website_account_deleted]; the full flow gives [requested, rapid_fire_erased, rapid_fire_erased_again, website_account_deleted]. 'cancel' erases nothing and a later complete returns 409. Requested suites: 38/38 passed. New iter125 suite: 6/6 passed. Live regression passed: 422 never echoes the PIN, DEL-AAAA-AAAA returns 404, owner API returns 401 with no session and 403 with no X-Owner-Panel header, both pages render. Backend log shows no tracebacks and no sweep errors. `expo config` shows a single expo-build-properties entry with manifestQueries [com.whatsapp, com.whatsapp.w4b] AND enableMinifyInReleaseBuilds=false; extra.backendUrl is set. package-lock.json is gone and yarn.lock remains. UI at 390px: /delete-account shows 4 steps plus the form; submit stays disabled for every invalid combination and is enabled only with a valid number + 4-digit PIN + DELETE; the confirm sheet opens and 'Keep' closes it. No delete request was sent, and the route was blocked as a safeguard. QA learner sign-in goes to Home, and the Rapid Fire tab loads with the learner's data intact (Lv 3, 106 coins). No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Small race: erase_companion runs after a non-atomic find_one and before the atomic find_one_and_update. If an owner 'cancel' lands in between, the Rapid Fire data is erased but the request is saved as 'cancelled'. Owner-only and unlikely; it could be closed by first flipping state to a 'completing' marker atomically.

action_items: Optional: make owner 'complete' atomic. Claim the request first (e.g. set state 'completing' via find_one_and_update), then erase, then finish, so a concurrent cancel can never end up with erased data on a cancelled request.
critical_code_review_comments: owner_panel.decide: erase happens before the conditional update, so a 409 response can follow an erase in a race (see minor issue).
app.config.js only merges into an existing expo-build-properties entry. If app.json ever drops that plugin, the minify/shrink overrides go silently with it. Fine today: there is exactly one entry.
seed_data_creation: Scratch DB <DB_NAME>_deletion_selftest only: TEST-del-* rf_profiles/rf_feed rows, account_deletions docs (name TEST_iter125) and owner_sessions (which expire after 1 h). Nothing was written to the main DB or the canonical website.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini adds xdist (-n). Run single files with -n0. On RN-web /entry, use click + keyboard.type rather than page.fill + force click: the fill+force approach did not submit. Always route-block /api/account/delete-request when signed in as the QA learner.
rca_of_issue: BLOCKER DESTRUCTIVE_DB_STARTUP: resolved. The background sweep no longer calls any erase path. The late-row clean-up has moved to the owner's 'complete' press.
